intro: This sound healing course in Ubud, Bali contains all the syllabuses of our Level 1/2/3 Sound Healing Courses to gain the deepest knowledge and skills to become a professional sound healer. Our school campus is nestled in the heart of Bali – Ubud. Away from the noise, surrounded by lush greenery and the serene beauty of nature, short ride to the center of Ubud.

We have designed this sound healing training in Bali to immerse you in the ancient art of sound healing, blending traditional wisdom with modern techniques. You will learn to harness the power of various sound tools, including Tibetan singing bowls, gongs, happy drum, ocean drum, rain sticks, and your own voice, to create harmonic vibrations that promote physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being.

Our experienced sound healing teachers are here to guide you every step of the way to acquire proper knowledge and skills of sound healing techniques. Whether you are a yoga teacher, therapist, or simply someone eager to heal yourself or your loved ones, this course will empower you to integrate sound healing into your personal and professional life.

To enhance your transformative journey at Bali Yoga School, we also have included daily yoga classes and massage treatments. In your free time, you can study by our two swimming pools under the shining sun, or enjoy sunbathing by the pool surrounded by green in the tranquil atmosphere.
